archive.catalogue_description: THIS MAP WAS MADE IN 2 Days This map is based in a old village and 2 Germans went to check out the house, it was a derelict house and they had been sent there to see what happened inside, all of a sudden zombies came threw the door, braking down barriers, can you kill the Germans and kill the zombies? Includes: All four perk machines buy able ppsh secret gun easteregg risers Known bugs: Derping zombie at the start (not every round) Answer to that is because this map was a 2 day challenge and i tried fixing the zombies but i couldn’t seem to, sorry about that but everything is pretty much flawless! hope you enjoy….

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
